title: Lamb Pilaf with Greek Flair
description: A French-inspired dish that combines the flavors of lamb and pilaf with a touch of Greek cuisine.
instructions: Season the lamb cubes with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and rosemary to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the lamb and garlic.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pilaf is tender and the lamb is cooked through.
